scripts.build:data: node scripts/build-expanded-data.mjs && node scripts/build-data.mjs && node scripts/build-tcm-data.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run build:data && npm run validate-data
scripts.build: npm run build:data && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const p='dist';fs.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync(p+'/generated',{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync(p+'/icons',{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync(p+'/public/data/cn',{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync(p+'/public/data/tcm',{recursive:true});['index.html','styles.css','app.js','atlas-bootstrap.js','foods-expanded.js','manifest.webmanifest','sw.js'].filter(f=>fs.existsSync(f)).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,p+'/'+f));['icons/icon.svg','icons/icon-192.png','icons/icon-512.png'].filter(f=>fs.existsSync(f)).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,p+'/'+f));['generated/foods-cn-bundle.js','generated/foods-expanded-bulk.js','generated/recipes-bulk.js','generated/tcm-herbs-bundle.js','generated/classic-diet-recipes.js','generated/handcrafted-recipes.js','generated/pairing-rules-extra.js','generated/food-id-aliases.js','generated/food-medicine-catalog.js'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,p+'/'+f);});const pubCn='public/data/cn';if(fs.existsSync(pubCn)){fs.readdirSync(pubCn).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(pubCn+'/'+f,p+'/public/data/cn/'+f));}const pubTcm='public/data/tcm';if(fs.existsSync(pubTcm)){fs.readdirSync(pubTcm).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(pubTcm+'/'+f,p+'/public/data/tcm/'+f));}"
